prompt:
Judge one fact extracted for a SysML v2 model from an engineering document. The fact names elements by their full names; the document may refer to them by aliases declared elsewhere (those declarations are included).

Fact: composition(whole=end-to-end figure, parts=['encryption overhead', 'firewall inspection time'])

Source sentences (the last one is where the fact was extracted):
S060: Critical contact paths are pinned before acquisition of signal when the Ground Network Manager determines that a maintenance condition could cause route oscillation.
S061: Management access to routers, firewalls, time servers, and monitoring probes is restricted to dedicated administration networks that are not advertised to mission data enclaves.
S062: Latency budgets are assigned by service class so that command validation, real-time telemetry display, orbit determination support, processing transfers, and archive replication can be measured against different expectations.
S063: The budget for real-time command and telemetry traffic between the Mission Control Center, the Command Validation Gateway, and the Telemetry Ingest Service is managed as an end-to-end figure that includes encryption overhead and firewall inspection time.

"supported": every slot value is stated or directly implied by the sentences. "partially_supported": the main relation is right but a slot is wrong, over-specific or unsupported. "unsupported": the fact is not stated, contradicts the text, or assigns the wrong element. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"supported","reason":"S063 says the end-to-end figure includes encryption overhead and firewall inspection time, which directly matches the composition of those two parts in the whole."}
